rules.sentence: Jacobsen syndrome is a rare condition, affecting approximately 1 in 100,000 births and is more common in females, with a female-to-male ratio of 2:1.
Thrombocytopenia is present in 95% of patients and is most pronounced in the neonatal period, although it often improves with age.
In addition to thrombocytopenia, all patients with Jacobsen syndrome have Paris-Trousseau syndrome, characterized by dysfunctional platelets with giant alpha granules.
